Photographed city surface materials from Poly Haven

Asphalt 02 — Rob Tuytel
https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02
Original sampled width: 3 metres.
Included: unchanged 1K diffuse, OpenGL normal and roughness JPG maps.

Concrete Pavement 02 — Charlotte Baglioni
https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_pavement_02
Original sampled width: 1.8 metres.
Included: unchanged 1K diffuse JPG map.

All included assets: CC0 1.0 Universal (public-domain dedication).

https://polyhaven.com/license

These are generic photographed materials, not scans of Gangnam roads. They change
rendered surface shading only; the simulation's road height and friction model
remain independent. See provenance.json for original URLs, sizes and hashes.
